verses.text: Woe to the land of whirring wings,
All you people of the world
For this is what the LORD has told me:
For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone
They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey,
At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of Hosts— to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
